title: Spain and France wildfires force more than 300,000 to flee as Macron calls crisis meeting
summary: Massive wildfires in France's Bordeaux region and Spain have forced over 300,000 people to evacuate, with local officials describing the economic impact as devastating. President Macron is convening a crisis meeting to address the disaster.
content: The impact of a gigantic wildfire ravaging France's Bordeaux region and Spain has been like a "clap of thunder" for the local economy, a minister said.

zh.title: 西班牙和法国野火迫使30多万人逃离，马克龙召集危机会议
zh.summary: 法国波尔多地区和西班牙的大规模野火已迫使超过30万人疏散，当地官员形容经济影响是毁灭性的。马克龙总统正在召开危机会议来应对这场灾难。

title: ‘I feel lucky’: I’m 71 and inherited $20,000. What should I do with this money?
summary: A 71-year-old seeks guidance on managing a $20,000 inheritance alongside existing retirement accounts including an IRA, high-yield savings, CDs, and other savings vehicles.
content: “I have an IRA, a high-yield savings account, four CDs and checking and savings accounts.”

zh.title: "我感到幸运"：我71岁，继承了20,000美元。我应该怎样处理这笔钱？
zh.summary: 一位71岁的人寻求指导，了解如何管理20,000美元的继承遗产以及现有的退休账户，包括个人退休账户、高收益储蓄、存款证和其他储蓄工具。

title: Three killed, four wounded in Seattle food festival shooting, police say
summary: A shooting at a downtown Seattle food festival on Sunday killed three people and injured four others, including a toddler, highlighting ongoing gun violence at public events.
content: Three people were killed and four others, including a toddler, were wounded on Sunday in a shooting at a downtown Seattle food festival, police said.

zh.title: 警方称西雅图美食节枪击事件造成三人死亡，四人受伤
zh.summary: 周日发生在西雅图市中心美食节上的枪击事件造成三人死亡，四人受伤，其中包括一名幼童，凸显了公共活动中持续存在的枪支暴力问题。

title: A look at Cher’s $85 million Malibu home, after she spent $1 million in legal fees in lawsuit
summary: Singer Cher has been ordered to pay $1 million in legal fees following a lawsuit against the widow of her ex-husband Sonny Bono, an outcome highlighted alongside her $85 million Malibu property.
content: Singing sensation Cher will be forced to pay the $1 million in legal fees that she incurred during a bitter legal battle against the widow of her ex-husband Sonny Bono.

zh.title: 歌手雪儿的8500万美元马里布豪宅：诉讼中花费100万美元法律费用后的一览
zh.summary: 歌手雪儿因与她已故前夫桑尼·博诺遗孀的诉讼被判支付100万美元的法律费用，这一结果与她的8500万美元马里布房产一起被重点提及。

title: ‘Ransom Canyon’ star Josh Duhamel: The self-described ‘doomsday prepper’ quickly sells $3.4 million L.A. home
summary: Actor Josh Duhamel has closed the sale of his Los Angeles home for over $3.4 million, exceeding the asking price. The self-described doomsday prepper's quick sale demonstrates strong demand in the LA real estate market.
content: “Ransom Canyon” star Josh Duhamel has officially closed on the sale of his Los Angeles home, selling the picturesque property for more than his asking price.

zh.title: 《赎金峡谷》明星乔什·杜哈梅尔：自称"末日生存者"迅速售出340万美元洛杉矶豪宅
zh.summary: 演员乔什·杜哈梅尔以340多万美元的价格成交了他的洛杉矶房产销售，超过了要价。这位自称末日生存者的演员的快速销售显示了洛杉矶房地产市场的强劲需求。

title: Trump paused attacks on Iran to make space for talks, US ambassador says
summary: The U.S. and Iran have halted military strikes after nearly two weeks of escalating attacks, with the American ambassador stating the pause is designed to create diplomatic space for peace negotiations.
content: Neither the US nor Iran have launched attacks in the last two nights, after almost two weeks of tit-for-tat strikes risked derailing talks to permanently end the war.

zh.title: 美国大使表示，特朗普暂停对伊朗的攻击为谈判腾出空间
zh.summary: 在近两周的升级攻击后，美国和伊朗已停止军事打击，美国大使表示这一暂停旨在为和平谈判创造外交空间。

title: U.S. and Iran pause fighting to give peace talks 'space.' Here's where negotiations stand
summary: A temporary cease-fire between the U.S. and Iran held on Monday as peace negotiations continued, though talks faced fresh obstacles over the weekend in efforts to achieve a lasting resolution.
content: A temporary pause to the U.S.-Iran conflict appeared to hold on Monday, after negotiations over a lasting peace faced fresh hurdles over the weekend.

zh.title: 美国和伊朗暂停战斗为和平谈判"让步"。以下是谈判进展情况
zh.summary: 美国和伊朗之间的临时停火在周一生效，和平谈判继续进行，尽管周末谈判面临新的障碍，但双方正在努力实现持久解决方案。

title: Chinese chipmaker shares surge 470% in blockbuster stock market debut
summary: A Chinese chipmaker surged 470% in its stock market debut, driven by strong investor demand for semiconductor companies benefiting from the artificial intelligence boom.
content: The company's shares soared by 470% in its market debut, as the AI boom drives chip demand.

zh.title: 中国芯片制造商股价在大热上市中飙升470%
zh.summary: 一家中国芯片制造商在其股票上市首日上升了470%，这是由于投资者对受人工智能热潮惠及的半导体公司的强劲需求所驱动的。

title: Will summer discounts make family days out cheaper?
summary: Parents welcome summer promotional discounts for family outings but report that recreation activities can still cost over £100 per day when all expenses are totaled.
content: Parents welcome summer discounts but say days out can still cost more than £100.

zh.title: 夏季折扣会让家庭出游更便宜吗？
zh.summary: 父母欢迎夏季促销折扣用于家庭出游，但报告显示，当计算所有费用时，娱乐活动每天仍可能花费超过100英镑。

title: Why Trump's new tariff blitz is very different this time round
summary: President Trump announced tariffs on Friday targeting 60 trading partners including the EU, China, and the U.K., marking a significant shift in trade policy with a broader and different approach than previous efforts.
content: President Trump on Friday launched a fresh round of tariffs targeting 60 trading partners, including the European Union, China, and the U.K.

zh.title: 特朗普新关税突击为何这次大不相同
zh.summary: 特朗普总统周五宣布针对包括欧盟、中国和英国在内的60个贸易伙伴的关税，标志着贸易政策的重大转变，采取了比以前更广泛和不同的方式。

title: Indonesia central bank governor Perry Warjiyo steps down in surprise move
summary: Indonesia's central bank governor Perry Warjiyo unexpectedly resigned Monday, triggering investor concerns about the central bank's independence and the trajectory of the country's fiscal policy.
content: Indonesia's central bank governor, Perry Warjiyo, resigned on Mon. in a surprise move, raising investor fears over central bank independence and fiscal policy.

zh.title: 印度尼西亚央行行长佩里·瓦吉约突然辞职
zh.summary: 印度尼西亚央行行长佩里·瓦吉约周一突然辞职，引发投资者对央行独立性和该国财政政策轨迹的担忧。

title: Oil prices sink, stock futures rally as U.S. and Iran pause attacks, Wall Street awaits busy week
summary: U.S. stock futures rallied and oil prices fell as the U.S. and Iran paused military actions, while Wall Street prepares for the Federal Reserve's meeting and major tech earnings reports. The de-escalation reduces geopolitical risk and commodity uncertainty heading into a data-heavy week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures rallied and oil prices tumbled on Sunday as the U.S. and Iran took a pause from fighting, and as Wall Street gears up for the Fed’s meeting and key earnings reports from Big Tech companies.

zh.title: 油价下跌，股指期货上涨，美国和伊朗暂停攻击，华尔街迎接繁忙周期
zh.summary: 随着美国和伊朗暂停军事行动，美国股指期货上涨，油价下跌，华尔街为美联储会议和主要科技公司财报做准备。地缘政治风险和商品不确定性的缓解为即将到来的数据密集周做铺垫。

title: China memory chipmaker CXMT skyrockets 470% in blockbuster Shanghai debut
summary: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT surged 470% on its Shanghai debut, raising 57.92 billion yuan ($8.6 billion) at 8.66 yuan per share. The blockbuster gain reflects strong investor demand for domestic semiconductor companies amid China's push for tech self-sufficiency.
content: The Hefei-based company raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.6 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan per share.

zh.title: 中国存储芯片制造商CXMT在上海上市首日飙升470%
zh.summary: 中国存储芯片制造商CXMT在上海上市首日飙升470%，融资57.92亿元（86亿美元），发行价为8.66元/股。这一突出表现反映了投资者对国内半导体公司的强劲需求，以及中国推进技术自主的决心。

title: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs hit sales
summary: Fast fashion giant Shein reported a $99 million loss as Trump tariffs dampened sales ahead of its Hong Kong stock market debut. The company faces near-term headwinds from trade policy while pursuing its IPO strategy.
content: The announcement comes as the fast fashion giant prepares for its stock market debut in Hong Kong.

zh.title: 特朗普关税冲击销售，Shein陷入9900万美元亏损
zh.summary: 快时尚巨头Shein报告9900万美元亏损，特朗普关税削弱了销售表现，公司即将在香港上市。该公司在推进IPO战略的同时，面临贸易政策带来的短期阻力。

title: China industrial profit growth slows again in June as retreating oil prices sap earnings lift
summary: China's industrial profit growth decelerated in June as falling oil prices reduced earnings momentum, though corporate profits remain up double-digits from near-zero growth in 2025. The slowdown illustrates how commodity price volatility continues affecting manufacturing profitability.
content: Corporate earnings have staged one of the strongest turnarounds in the economy this year, swinging from barely positive growth in 2025 to double-digit gains.

zh.title: 中国6月工业利润增速再次放缓，油价下跌削弱收益增长
zh.summary: 中国6月工业利润增速放缓，原油价格下跌削弱了收益增长动力，但企业利润仍然比2025年接近零增长的情况增长了两位数。这种放缓说明商品价格波动继续影响制造业盈利能力。

title: Singapore tightens monetary policy as rising oil prices rekindle inflation risk
summary: Singapore's central bank is tightening monetary policy to combat inflation risks from rising oil prices, using its unique approach of managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate rather than traditional interest rate adjustments. The move reflects the city-state's vulnerability to commodity shocks.
content: Unlike most central banks, the MAS manages medium-term price stability by managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of currencies.

zh.title: 新加坡因油价上升重燃通胀风险而收紧货币政策
zh.summary: 新加坡中央银行正在收紧货币政策以应对油价上升带来的通胀风险，采取其独特的管理新加坡元汇率的方法，而非传统的利率调整。此举反映了这个城市国家对商品冲击的脆弱性。
